# ANALYSIS: TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO OOS Real-Fills A/B Test

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The call-veto knob in TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO blocks CALL entries when bearish market structure is confirmed. On J's anchor days, it is expected to block the combined -$165 CALL loser on 5/07 (734C x3 and 737C x10) while leaving the three PUT winners unaffected, yielding an incremental edge_capture of +$165. We hypothesize this effect holds out-of-sample over 16 months of real OPRA fills.

## Mechanism

- **Entry trigger:** The existing TRENDLINE_BREAK signal fires when a respected ascending support is broken on the 5m chart.
- **Call-veto:** When enabled, the engine vetoes any CALL entry signal if `market_structure.classify_trend` indicates bearish structure on the same 5m bar.
- **Exit logic:** Unchanged from base strategy (chart stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +50%, runner, time stop 15:50 ET).
- **A/B test:** Compares two configurations over 16-month OOS period (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using real OPRA fills:
  - Control: `call_veto_enabled = false`
  - Treatment: `call_veto_enabled = true`

## Expected impact on OP-16 anchors

| J day | Current engine behavior (call_veto=false) | Proposed behavior (call_veto=true) | Delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4/29 winner | Takes SPY 710P x6 -> +$342 | Unchanged (PUT winner) | $0 |
| 5/01 winner | Takes SPY 721P x20 -> +$470 | Unchanged | $0 |
| 5/04 winner | Takes SPY 721P x10 -> +$730 | Unchanged | $0 |
| 5/05 loser | Skips or loses less on SPY 722P x20 -> -$260 | Unchanged (PUT loser) | $0 |
| 5/06 loser | Unchanged on SPY 730P x10 -> -$300 | Unchanged (PUT loser) | $0 |
| 5/07 loser (CALL) | Takes SPY 734C x3 + 737C x10 -> -$165 | Skips these CALL entries if bearish structure confirmed | +$165 (if both blocked) |

*Note: If call-veto fires on only one of the two CALL signals, delta would be proportionally less.*

## OP-20 disclosures (for the test)

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L. Results scaled to $1K paper account.
2. **Sample bias:** 16-month OOS window (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18), time-based selection. Overfit risk: medium (single knob test).
3. **Out-of-sample:** OOS test by definition; walk-forward held-out window to be reported post-test.
4. **Real-fills:** Uses cached real OPRA fills; top-3 J days verified for slippage < ±20% vs BS-sim.
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Incorrect CALL veto on non-J winner → opportunity loss.
   - Max drawdown: Monitored via equity curve.
   - Blow-up: Over-vetoing turns strategy net loser by blocking too many winners.
6. **Concentration:** Will report top-5 days' % of incremental P&L from call-veto.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators for `market_structure.py` changes must pass.
- Walk-forward OOS positive (IS/OOS ratio ≥ 0.70) within the 16-month window.
- Real-fills check on top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) showing < ±20% P&L diff vs BS-sim.
- Anchor no-regression: PUT winners unchanged, 5/07 CALL loss reduced.

## Confidence

6 / 10 -- Hypothesis grounded in observed 5/07 market structure break, but OOS validation pending.
